examples.problem: Evaluate $f(t) = 9u(t-9)$ at $t=9,$ where $u$ is the unit step function.
examples.worked_solution:
The unit step function $u(t)$ is defined as

$$
{\begin{aligned}1,\,t\ge 0, \\ 0,\,t<0.\end{aligned}
$$

Evaluating $f(t)$ at $t=9,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}f(9) & =9u(9-9) \\  & =9u(0) \\  & =9\cdot 1 \\  & =9.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $f(9)=9.$
